items.title: Cards Animation
items.description: Eighteen cards fly in from alternating sides, spinning and scaling down from four times their size, then settle onto a giant wheel whose pivot sits 200vh below the stage — so only the top arc is ever on screen and the cards fan out like a hand being dealt. Scrolling turns the wheel: the component owns its own scroll runway under a sticky stage, reads its own scrollTop and eases it, so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed. Most cards are duotoned monochrome with a few warm and cool accents applied through CSS filters, so the palette holds regardless of what each photo looks like, and full colour returns on hover. Click a card and it opens a detail panel — the artwork at full colour beside its title and description, dismissed with the backdrop or Escape. Every selector is scoped through gsap.context to the component's own root, so two instances on one page cannot drive each other. Deal-in choreography after a GSAP study by @deadrabbbbit, itself inspired by the Hyundai site.

items.title: Scroll 1 Animation
items.description: A wall of images rotated 25° on the Y axis, each tile parked at a random depth between −1600 and 200px, sweeping right across the viewport as you scroll while the inner picture scales from 2 down to 0.5 — so the frame travels but the photograph inside it settles. Built with GSAP ScrollTrigger on a scrubbed timeline, with Lenis smoothing the component's own scroll container rather than the page — the root is both the Lenis wrapper and the ScrollTrigger scroller, so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed. One of six on-scroll perspective grid animations from Codrops' Scroll3DGrid (MIT, Codrops), split into a component per animation.

items.title: Scroll 2 Animation
items.description: Tiles rise out of deep space — pushed 1000 to 3000px back — turning from −45° to 45° and dimming from double brightness to black as they pass, while the whole grid counter-rotates and scales up beneath them. Built with GSAP ScrollTrigger on a scrubbed timeline, with Lenis smoothing the component's own scroll container rather than the page — the root is both the Lenis wrapper and the ScrollTrigger scroller, so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed. One of six on-scroll perspective grid animations from Codrops' Scroll3DGrid (MIT, Codrops), split into a component per animation.

items.title: Scroll 3 Animation
items.description: The grid starts 5000px away, pitched back on its top edge and unlit, then flattens and brightens as the whole wrap rushes 6500px toward the camera — a flythrough where the destination assembles itself on approach. Built with GSAP ScrollTrigger on a scrubbed timeline, with Lenis smoothing the component's own scroll container rather than the page — the root is both the Lenis wrapper and the ScrollTrigger scroller, so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed. One of six on-scroll perspective grid animations from Codrops' Scroll3DGrid (MIT, Codrops), split into a component per animation.

items.title: Scroll 4 Animation
items.description: A narrow column seen from its left edge. Each tile hinges on its top edge from −70° to 70° while stepping 500px toward the camera and back again on a 0.04s stagger — pages turning in sequence rather than all at once. Built with GSAP ScrollTrigger on a scrubbed timeline, with Lenis smoothing the component's own scroll container rather than the page — the root is both the Lenis wrapper and the ScrollTrigger scroller, so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed. One of six on-scroll perspective grid animations from Codrops' Scroll3DGrid (MIT, Codrops), split into a component per animation.

items.title: Scroll 5 Animation
items.description: A gapless field laid almost flat at 50°. Even rows slide left and odd rows slide right, tearing the image apart along its own seams, then every tile drifts vertically once the rows have parted. Built with GSAP ScrollTrigger on a scrubbed timeline, with Lenis smoothing the component's own scroll container rather than the page — the root is both the Lenis wrapper and the ScrollTrigger scroller, so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed. One of six on-scroll perspective grid animations from Codrops' Scroll3DGrid (MIT, Codrops), split into a component per animation.

items.title: Scroll 6 Animation
items.description: Tiles hinge from a pivot two heights below themselves, swinging up from 400% down while spinning a full 360° on the Y axis, fading to a fifth opacity on a 0.03s stagger — a deck flipping itself into place. Built with GSAP ScrollTrigger on a scrubbed timeline, with Lenis smoothing the component's own scroll container rather than the page — the root is both the Lenis wrapper and the ScrollTrigger scroller, so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed. One of six on-scroll perspective grid animations from Codrops' Scroll3DGrid (MIT, Codrops), split into a component per animation.

items.title: Companion Grid
items.description: Inspired by the companion.uprock.pro website design — a warm, cream editorial section where a headline sits behind a train of polaroid cards. Scrolling drives the train to the right on lenis-style easing, each card zigzagging up and down with a tilt that drifts as it crosses the screen and a sine bob layered on top, so the cards clear away one at a time and the line underneath is revealed. The run starts on the last card and ends on the first. The component owns its own scroll container — a tall track under a sticky viewport — so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed, and two blurred radial glows give the cream backdrop its warmth.

items.title: Featured1 Grid
items.description: A dark three-up feature grid on a blueprint backdrop. The headline wraps its first word in a Figma-style selection box — hollow stroked type with four corner handles that pop in after the line settles — and the grid pattern is masked so it dissolves before reaching the content. Three ruled columns each hold a panelled screenshot card with corner screws and a caption beneath, lifting on hover. Collapses to a single stacked column with horizontal rules below 900px.

items.title: Featured10 Grid
items.description: Inspired by the vanlent.dev website design — an engineering-blueprint layout where bordered cells sit over a faint graph-paper backdrop like a technical drawing. Both visuals are drawn rather than imaged: the globe is a dot field clipped to a circle and masked so the dots thin toward the middle, which is what reads as a sphere, and the gear train is generated from a path function that alternates outer and inner radius per tooth, each gear rotating at its own speed and direction. A word row, a marker-style highlight block that sweeps open, a stepped progress indicator, a testimonial carousel and a tick ruler complete the plate. No images and no dependencies.

items.title: Featured11 Grid
items.description: Inspired by the harrisoncarloss.com website design — a rounded media card with a stack of category names down the left. Hovering, focusing or clicking a name cross-fades the background between mixed video and image layers and swaps the panel on the right with its blurb, headline stat and label. Every layer stays mounted and only opacity changes, so a switch never re-decodes an image or re-buffers a clip, and only the active clip is playing. The Discover More control sits as a bare circle at rest and expands into a filled pill with an arrow on hover, the arrow animating on max-width so it grows from nothing without a layout jump. Includes a floating pill navbar and a staggered entrance.

items.title: Featured2 Grid
items.description: Inspired by the air.inc website design — a frosted-glass bento grid floating over a looping sky video. Seven cards across a 12-column layout (7/5, then 5/7, then a 3-up row) each use backdrop-filter with a light-catching top gradient so the moving clouds read straight through them. Artwork bleeds past the card padding to the bottom edge, and the three closing cards are text-only. Collapses to a single stacked column below 1100px.

items.title: Featured3 Grid
items.description: Three tall AI feature cards on black, each with a photographic background and a live interactive surface. The first holds a frosted glass panel whose question-and-answer pair crossfades through a blur every four seconds; the second draws an SVG forecast chart that wipes in behind an animated clip-path with a marker that pops on the peak; the third builds a categorization tree whose connectors are measured from live DOM positions via ResizeObserver, with light pulses travelling along each path on a loop. Everything animates once the section scrolls into view.

items.title: Featured4 Grid
items.description: Two analytics cards on black, sliding in from opposite sides as the section scrolls into view. The wider card holds a frosted glass overview panel with a currency figure that counts up on a rAF cubic ease and three gradient progress bars that fill in behind it; the second layers a floating white stat card, a portrait cutout, and a glass action row over a photographic background. Numbers use tabular figures so the counter doesn't jitter as digits change.

items.title: Featured5 Grid
items.description: A six-column highlights grid on near-black, laid out 4+2 then 2+4 across two rows. Cards use 48px radii, a hairline border and a top-to-bottom translucent wash. One card renders a layered concentric-arc mark built entirely in SVG — a blurred glow pass, a hairline pass, a mid-weight body and a white radial highlight, all sharing the same four arc paths. Another holds a working command palette whose rows highlight on hover, click, and arrow-key navigation, wired up with listbox semantics. The entrance lands each empty card frame first, then settles its contents in: the keyboard is set down onto the surface, the marks bloom out of a blur, and the palette results cascade in one row at a time. Collapses to a horizontal scroller below 991px.

items.title: Featured6 Grid
items.description: Inspired by the madewithgsap.com website design — a light showcase section with an oversized two-tone headline and a rail of three black video cards. The rail is deliberately wider than the viewport: three cards at 40vw plus gaps overflow past 100vw, so the middle card sits centred while the outer two clip against the section edges, reading as a carousel without any scroll logic. A floating white pill nav with a count badge and a lime CTA sits above, and a meta pill row underneath. Headline set in LayGrotesk 500 with the stack falling back to Helvetica Neue and Inter.

items.title: Featured7 Grid
items.description: A warm off-white feature section framed like a blueprint — full-bleed top and bottom rules crossed by two inset vertical rails, with a hairline crosshair sitting on each of the four intersections. A bordered pill badge with a green FREE chip sits above a heavy tight-tracked headline. Three white cards follow, each with a rounded icon tile, title, copy and artwork flush at the bottom. Rails and crosshairs are positioned from a single custom property, so the frame stays aligned at any width and pulls in on mobile.

items.title: Featured8 Grid
items.description: A warm off-white dashboard grid on a blueprint frame — two inset vertical rails crossed by a single bottom rule, with a hairline crosshair on each intersection. A bordered pill badge with a red PRO chip sits above a heavy tight-tracked two-line headline. Three columns follow: single tall cards left and right that read copy-first, and a centre column stacking two cards that lead with their artwork. Cards lift and their artwork scales gently on hover. On appear the outer columns swing in from their own edges while the stacked pair rises, so the composition closes inward.

items.title: Featured9 Grid
items.description: A black next-project rail with an oversized pale-blue headline that the video row rides up and over — a negative margin crops the second word exactly the way the reference does. Each clip stays paused until its own card is hovered; the other two then fall behind a black shade and their labels drop to grey, so nothing competes with what is playing. Cards are full-bleed with 3px seams, each carrying an index, title and FULL PROJECT link underneath. On appear the two headline words push up from under each other and the rail wipes upward via clip-path, so it reads as sliding over the type.

items.title: Paper Grid
items.description: Three translucent certificates hang side by side over one giant wordmark, each printed on glass and bending like real paper — the curl is integrated along the sheet rather than pushed in Z, so the silhouette genuinely pulls in where the page turns away from the light. Drag a sheet to turn it and the throw carries, decaying to rest on the nearest whole rotation; hover and a point light tracks the cursor while the lit sheet lifts toward the camera to win the overlap. All three share one WebGL context, one renderer and one procedural environment map, and every sheet reads the same bend field at a different phase so they never breathe in lockstep. The type is drawn to canvas, so no webfont is fetched. The component measures its own container and binds pointer events to it, so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed. 3D scene ported from ThreeUI's ThreeDPaper (MIT, Meng To / Design+Code).

items.title: Air Hero
items.description: Inspired by the air.inc website design — a cinematic full-screen hero with a looping sky video background, transparent floating navbar, and a 3D spring-tilt product video card. Tab pills (Organize / Approve / Multiply) swap the card video with AnimatePresence fade transitions. Built with motion/react springs (useMotionValue, useSpring) for ±8° rotateX/Y tilt on hover, plus staggered entrance animations on headline, CTA, card, and tabs.

items.title: Amero Hero
items.description: AI design-reference finder hero with animated pixel-grid backgrounds, typewriter prompt, folder stack reveal, and floating reference cards.

items.title: Amind Hero
items.description: Inspired by the mymind website — purely as a creative reference for fellow developers, no affiliation or commercial intent. Features a blurred radial gradient backdrop, white circle overlay, colorful tag bubbles, animated entrance transitions, app store buttons, and an auto-playing product video.

items.title: Bevel Hero
items.description: Inspired by the bevel.health website design — a clean white editorial hero with a bold Georgia serif headline, eyebrow social-proof text, and an infinite auto-scrolling strip of portrait reel cards (Instagram-style). Each card shows a Cloudinary image with a user avatar, like/comment counts, and caption overlays. Left and right white gradient fades complete the marquee effect. Entrance animations powered by motion/react with staggered delays on eyebrow, headline, sub-copy, and the reel strip.

items.title: Bluish Hero
items.description: A soft blue SaaS hero with a floating white nav pill, concentric background rings, and a full event-management dashboard mockup. Seven category tabs (Venue, Décor, Food & Beverage, Entertainment, Guest Communications, Logistics, Final Go Live) each swap in their own set of cards, and the tilted label chips flanking the dashboard select the matching tab. Chips deal in from off-canvas with rotation overshoot then settle into a staggered idle float, and the selected tab's icon fills navy to echo the chip styling.

items.title: Brutal Hero
items.description: Minimal brutalist hero with navbar, theme toggle, pixel-style headlines, animated SVG workflow diagram, and mono CTA button.

items.title: Caldera Hero
items.description: Light marketing hero with navbar, clipped dual-panel video mask, Oswald headline, and bottom-right CTA. Uses scoped color tokens and a remote Framer video URL.

items.title: Card Hero
items.description: Full-screen video hero with a centered glassmorphism pill navbar, large editorial headline, and a 3D tilt story card that follows the cursor via framer-motion springs. The card cycles two slides with progress bar animations, a person image with a sea-blue soft-light overlay, and frosted-glass action buttons.

items.title: Crnacura Hero
items.description: Editorial menu hero with 3D letter hover reveals, GSAP image previews on menu items, custom cursor, Zepa logo header, and centered body copy on a warm off-white canvas.

items.title: Data Analytics Hero
items.description: Dark hero with gradient glow, grain texture, mask-reveal headline, CTAs, and animated dashboard mockup.

items.title: Drops Hero
items.description: Dark fullscreen hero with GSAP mouse trail — images fall and bounce as the cursor moves. Zepa logo header, centered headline, and ten Cloudinary trail assets.

items.title: Figma Hero
items.description: Inspired by the David Suárez portfolio — a hero staged as a live Figma canvas. Hovering any text reveals a real selection box with blue outline, corner handles, and a "Text" layer tag. A custom black arrow cursor labelled "You" replaces the pointer while a purple "David" collaborator cursor wanders the canvas on its own with organic wobble. The middle name renders as a glitchy bitmap, re-shuffling its pixel palette every 700ms on a canvas element. Includes a live NYC clock, vertical column guides, and staggered fade-up entrance on the four hero blocks.

items.title: Glean Hero
items.description: Light marketing landing hero with scroll nav, mask-style sections, two-column cards, and product lifecycle grid. Uses scoped theme tokens and remote image URLs.

items.title: GLSL Hills Hero
items.description: Animated GLSL hills hero section powered by Three.js shaders.

items.title: Lena Hero
items.description: Fashion photographer portfolio hero with a counting preloader, draggable 3D spiral gallery that rotates on scroll, grayscale-to-color hover reveals, spiral/list view switch with image peek, rotating showreel badge, and a giant blend-mode serif title.

items.title: Mainframe Hero
items.description: Interactive hero with mouse-scrubbed background video, typewriter headline, pill CTAs, and mobile menu. Includes useTypewriter hook.

items.title: New Hero
items.description: Premium hero section with strong heading, CTA buttons, glow, and framed dashboard mockup.

items.title: Osmos Hero
items.description: Infinite auto-rotating curved card wheel hero — Osmo-style layout with a bold headline, pill tags, and a pure CSS 360° card carousel. Zero JavaScript animation, zero npm dependencies.

items.title: Oyo Hero
items.description: Originally created by Codrops. An editorial CSS Grid slideshow hero with curtain-wipe revealer animations. Three irregular grid layouts cycle via prev/next navigation — each layout repositions 13 grayscale photo cells, a large display name, vertical title, and body copy. Built with pure CSS animations and no external dependencies.

items.title: Paper Hero
items.description: Studio-style hero with a WebGL video card that chases the cursor and bends like a sheet of paper — massive black typography on a light canvas, live clock, and a paper-thin 3D plane with velocity-driven curvature.

items.title: Pop Hero
items.description: Inspired by pop.site — thanks to F. Albert for this amazing design. SaaS landing hero with a claim-your-domain input, centered iPhone mockup, and six floating UI cards fanned out at ±15° — extra-tall stage so the full phone reveals on scroll, soft gradient footer.

items.title: Poster Scroll Hero
items.description: Peacock-style infinite 3D poster wall powered by Three.js and live TMDB movie/TV poster data. Scroll or let it auto-drift.

items.title: Scroll1 Hero
items.description: Inspired by the voku.studio website design — an infinite horizontal gallery where images drift right to left and rise into a Gaussian arch as they pass the center. Wheel and drag scrub the track with decaying momentum, and the centered project name crossfades in the nav as each image reaches the middle. Opens with a burst of auto-scroll momentum that eases to a slow drift over ~1.5s.

items.title: Scrolldown Hero
items.description: Inspired by the evanfasquelle.com website design — a trading-card portfolio where cards float up on buttery lenis-style easing while a giant background name marquee drifts sideways and speeds up with your scroll velocity. The component owns its own scroll container (a tall track under a sticky viewport), so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed. On load the deck lands first and each card is dealt out of it, flipping face-up in 3D; the holographic profile card catches light on a slow infinite shimmer. Includes a live progress percentage and a collected-cards counter.

items.title: Selfie Hero
items.description: Inspired by Yunus Emre Korkmaz's portfolio (yeqq.com.tr) — a huge thank you for such a wonderful piece of design. An editorial hero where an oversized word loop scrolls across the screen in black and turns white exactly where it crosses the centred video. Two identical marquees are stacked (one behind the video, one clipped to its box with clip-path) so they stay frame-perfect in sync without any JavaScript. The video sits in a frame with an animated colour halo and a pointer-tracked 3D tilt on hover, written straight to the DOM so it never re-renders. Rounded pill navigation, a live ticking clock, and an aperture-style reveal on load.

items.title: Slider Hero
items.description: Scroll-driven hero with cinematic card intro, fixed viewport card morph on scroll, hover name tags with breathe zoom, and two-section marketplace layout. Converted from Pallet Ross.

items.title: Synthesia Hero
items.description: Inspired by the synthesia.io website design — an AI video platform hero with an oversized two-tone headline whose accent words carry a periwinkle-to-indigo gradient, a G2 social-proof pill, and a large gradient card holding a product video. One video is split into five equal segments and each tab owns a slice: playback drives the active tab automatically, a white indicator pill springs between labels, and a faint fill inside it tracks progress through the current segment. Segment length is derived from the video's real duration, so swapping the source keeps the slices even. Includes a sticky navbar, staggered entrance choreography, and a mute toggle.

items.title: Vault Hero
items.description: Password-manager marketing hero with background video, framer-motion entrance animations, lucide icons, and mobile slide-out menu.

items.title: Vercel Hero
items.description: Dark 3D grid hero with react-three-fiber: animated boxes on an infinite grid and centered CTA copy.

items.title: Video Hero
items.description: An editorial full-screen video hero inspired by animusstudios.com. Oversized staggered display type wraps a centred 16:9 video panel with a scale-in entrance animation. Features a subtle SVG contour-wave background, corner-bracket hamburger, vertical side typography, and a bottom tagline — all animating in with staggered ease curves.

items.title: Wave Hero
items.description: Originally created by @franky-adl. An instanced 40×40 grid of tall cubes that ripple with expanding Gaussian wavefronts following the cursor. Built with Three.js — custom vertex shader injection, MouseTrail float texture, vignette + RGB-shift post-processing, and a GSAP staggered intro.

items.title: Zaveda Hero
items.description: Inspired by the aave.com app landing page — a savings-app hero on a soft lilac gradient with a sticky glass nav, a staggered entrance that lifts the badge, headline, subtitle and buttons in turn, and three phones fanned with the centre one raised and larger in front. Over the middle screen sits a live earnings readout built from real digit wheels: each decimal is its own clipped strip of slots ordered nine to zero, shifted with translateY on a --slot-h variable, and given a shorter transition the further right it sits, so the trailing decimals blur along while the leading ones barely move. Scrolling insets the stage and rounds its corners. The component owns its own scroll container, so it never touches window scroll or position:fixed.

items.title: Zoom Hero
items.description: Light fullscreen hero with GSAP ScrollSmoother and ScrollTrigger — layered mask zoom on scroll, split heading, and ten thumbnail images that fly off into depth.

items.title: Beam Zepa
items.description: Integration-beam illustration — six satellite nodes wired into a central hub, with a lit segment travelling along each curve. Left nodes feed inward, right nodes feed outward. Paths are measured from the live DOM with a ResizeObserver, so the curves stay correct at any width, and the travel is a CSS dash animation rather than an animation library.

items.title: Calendar Zepa
items.description: Month picker card — a graphite appointment tile with a six-week grid that never reflows, a brass disc that slides to the selected day, event ticks under busy dates, and a time strip whose period pill glides between AM and PM. Click the month name to pick another month without leaving the card.

items.title: Cards Zepa
items.description: A fanned card stack with pointer tilt — three cards splayed left, centre and right, each tilting in 3D as the pointer crosses it. Clicking a side card promotes it to the centre and the stack reshuffles. Placement and tilt live on separate elements so the interaction never fights the animation, and the reorder animates from transform alone with no layout projection.

items.title: Github Zepa
items.description: Contribution calendar — a year of activity as a seven-row grid of levelled cells, with month labels, a hover tooltip, a legend and a stats line. Columns align to real calendar weeks and crowded month labels are dropped automatically. Data arrives as a prop with a deterministic generated default, so nothing is requested at runtime.

items.title: Half Zepa
items.description: Report card pairing a horizontal bar chart with a divided metrics list. Bars grow from the left when the card scrolls into view, metric rows rise in behind them, and hovering a row reveals its value at the bar's end. The chart is a two-column CSS grid with an overlaid gridline layer, so there is no charting library behind it.

items.title: Notification Zepa
items.description: Lock-screen notification stack — two alerts rest on a wallpaper card, then the rest arrive one at a time, landing on top and pushing the stack down before the sequence loops. Cards are placed by transform rather than document flow, so the shuffle animates without any layout projection.

items.title: Notify Zepa
items.description: Notification card — a slowly turning aurora behind a halftone screen, a bell sitting in the dark eye at its centre, and a badge that ticks up every time the pointer crosses the bell. The backdrop is built from blurred gradients rather than a hosted clip, so it renders with nothing to download; pass a video source to swap it.

items.title: Report Zepa
items.description: Stacked area report card — three series drawn as smooth gradient areas with glowing top lines. The plot wipes in when it scrolls into view, and moving the pointer across it snaps a dashed marker to the nearest column with a readout. Paths are Catmull-Rom splines computed from the data, so there is no charting library behind it.

items.title: Ring Zepa
items.description: Concentric progress rings — three nested arcs that sweep to their values when the illustration scrolls into view, with the readouts counting up alongside them. Radii are derived from size, thickness and gap so any ring count works, and the resting state is the finished state, so the values still render correctly with motion reduced.

items.title: Threat Zepa
items.description: Detection card — a status banner with a spinning scanner, a signal beam curving down a rail, and a list of flagged entries. At rest the rows sit blurred behind grey markers; on hover the beam runs, each marker flips to an alert badge and the rows resolve in sequence. The rail path is measured and rebuilt on resize so the curve keeps its proportions at any height.

items.title: Timeline Zepa
items.description: Status timeline — a rail of nodes joined by connectors, each with a timestamp, title, description and optional content block. Steps reveal in sequence when the timeline scrolls into view, connectors draw down behind them, and the active node keeps a soft pulse. Vertical or horizontal, three densities, five statuses.

items.title: Zepa Diagram
items.description: Interactive data-viz illustration — a caption chip and a half-hidden donut at rest; on hover the chip drops away, the donut lifts and fills, six labelled nodes fly out around it, and a gradient rises from the floor. Container-query sized and re-colourable, so it drops into a bento tile, a feature card or a hero.

items.title: Zepa Folder
items.description: Interactive 3D folder illustration — files peek above the rim at rest, fan out on hover, and expand into a FLIP-animated lightbox on click. Re-colours and re-sizes from two props, so the same component drops into a bento tile, a feature card or a hero.

items.title: Zoom Zepa
items.description: Catalog loupe — three rivers of tags scroll past each other, and a glass sits on top. Drag it (or nudge it with the arrow keys) and the chips under the aperture sharpen, pick up colour, and enlarge around the point you are looking at. The rivers are CSS; the lens writes its position to custom properties, so a drag never re-renders.

items.title: Clipped Navbar
items.description: Full-bleed hero image with a floating white navbar card clipped into the top — small side and top gap lets the background bleed through all four corners. Centered logo, left nav links, email capture CTA, and a scrolling logo marquee at the bottom.

items.title: Cohort Navbar
items.description: Light navbar with Zepa logo, text-scramble hover on links, products mega-menu with alternating Cloudinary thumbnails, mobile accordion submenu, and hash placeholder routes.

items.title: Curved Navbar
items.description: Dark glassy pill-shaped navbar with a smooth framer-motion sliding active indicator, logo with diamond icon, and subtle backdrop blur.

items.title: Photo Navbar
items.description: Sticky navbar with a mega-dropdown featuring a photo card grid — grid-dot logo, centered nav links with animated chevrons, rounded white dropdown panel with a category list on the left and two photo cards on the right. Dark hero background with overlay.

items.title: Supaste Navbar
items.description: Dark frosted-glass navbar with an app icon, brand name, centered nav links, and an Apple-style Download CTA — inspired by Supaste.com.

items.title: Updated Navbar
items.description: Dark pill navbar with a white icon circle, centered nav links, and a white email CTA pill — on a clean white hero layout.

items.title: Blur Unicorn
items.description: Cinematic WebGL scene built with Unicorn Studio — soft blur aesthetic with botanical visuals, slow fade-in text overlays, and a full-bleed immersive layout.

items.title: Cat Unicorn
items.description: Music-driven WebGL hero featuring a 3D cat with animated EQ bars, scanlines, a live audio ticker, and a glass-shimmer headline. Autoplay background track with toggle control.

items.title: Cube Unicorn
items.description: 3D cube WebGL scene built with Unicorn Studio — animated cube with dynamic lighting and a centered text overlay.

items.title: Dove Unicorn
items.description: Gallery-white hover-reveal hero — a porcelain dove relief hides under a blank canvas until the cursor brushes it back into view. Museum-label typography, serif italic accents, and a hairline passe-partout frame.

items.title: Earth Unicorn
items.description: Surveillance-themed WebGL hero with a rotating 3D earth, global tracking aesthetic, and editorial typography.

items.title: Glass Unicorn
items.description: Glass morphism WebGL hero built with Unicorn Studio — fluid glass distortion with motion blur effects. Zepa logo top-left, large MOTION DESIGN text bottom-right.

items.title: Hand Unicorn
items.description: 3D marble hand WebGL scene built with Unicorn Studio — gradient-mapped dither animation with mouse trail effects and a centered text overlay.

items.title: Plane Unicorn
items.description: 3D interactive aircraft hero built with Unicorn Studio — cursor-tracked Airbus A380 against a deep space backdrop with red light trail, animated telemetry ticker, and SKYWINKS editorial branding.

items.title: Ramp Unicorn
items.description: Dithered WebGL background from Unicorn Studio with a cycling text hero — four Zepa taglines blur-transition every 4s over a blue-gradient dither scene.

items.title: Reveal Unicorn
items.description: Cinematic Spartan hover-reveal hero — move the cursor over the warrior and a bronze helmet materializes around his head. WebGL scene with battle-etching backdrop, editorial overlays, and a war-drum aesthetic.

items.title: Rigel Unicorn
items.description: Rigel-inspired WebGL scene built with Unicorn Studio — animated dithered background with layered effects and a centered Zepa text overlay.

items.title: Ring Unicorn
items.description: Deep-space WebGL hero built with Unicorn Studio — glowing ring or portal structure with pulse animation and dark editorial overlay.

items.title: Tree Unicorn
items.description: Editorial nature WebGL hero built with Unicorn Studio — ancient oak tree with a neon pixel mouse-reveal effect. Awwwards-style layout with specimen annotation panel.

items.title: Void Unicorn
items.description: Deep-space WebGL scene built with Unicorn Studio — dual 3D models with wisps, bloom, vignette, and mouse trail effects. Text overlays fade in after the sphere appear animation completes.

items.title: Walking Unicorn
items.description: Architectural WebGL hero shot from below a glass floor — silhouettes walk above you through frosted glass. POV perspective with editorial overlay and luxury elevation branding.
